name: Golgotha
overview: The Scriptures identify Golgotha as the specific location where Jesus was crucified, described in Aramaic as 'the place of a skull.' This name is also given in Hebrew, emphasizing the site's significance as the place of Christ's sacrificial death. Matthew 27:33, Mark 15:22, and John 19:17 consistently affirm this designation, highlighting Golgotha as the pivotal setting for the fulfillment of Christ’s redemptive work on the cross.
